step1_analysis.description: A bipolar Colpitts-style voltage-controlled oscillator. The tank circuit includes a varactor (diode-connected Q2) for frequency tuning, though the primary inductor appears to be missing or extracted as a resistor (e.g., R8) in this netlist.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends heavily on the LC tank values. With 1pF capacitors and assuming a 1nH inductor, f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*C)) ~= 5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 devices are slower than 200-GHz SiGe. Expected frequency is in the low GHz range if it oscillates.

phase_noise.description: Single sideband phase noise at a specific offset frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Phase noise scales with Q-factor and active device noise. SKY130 will likely have worse phase noise due to lower Q passives.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CMOS/BiCMOS phase noise at 1MHz offset for low-GHz VCOs.

output_power.description: RF output power delivered to the load.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = V^2 / (2*R). With 1.8V supply, max swing is ~1V. P ~= 10mW = 10 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower supply voltage (1.8V vs 5V) will reduce the maximum output power compared to the paper.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_dc. Assuming 5-10mA bias at 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for 1.8V supply in SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power and transient response of the VCO. Component values are assumed and appended since they were missing in the raw extraction.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param AREA_Q=1

* Generic NPN model for simulation
.model npn npn (is=1e-16 bf=100 vaf=50 cjc=0.1p cje=0.2p tf=10p)

* DUT (Values appended to raw netlist to allow simulation)
Q1 n2 n0 n1 npn {AREA_Q}
R1 n2 n4 50
C1 n1 n3 1p
C2 n0 n1 1p
C3 n3 n7 1p
R2 n1 n3 1k
R3 n0 n4 10k
R4 n0 n3 10k
C4 n5 n6 1p
R5 n7 n7 1
R6 n3 n6 10k
R7 n2 label_net_0 50
Q2 n7 n6 n6 npn {AREA_Q}
R8 n0 n5 1k

* Power and Bias Sources
V_n4 n4 0 1.8
V_n3 n3 0 0
VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 0.9

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let dc_power = -i(V_n4) * 1.8
  print dc_power
  print v(n2) v(n0) v(n1)

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 10n
  meas tran v_max max v(n2)
  meas tran v_min min v(n2)
  meas tran period trig v(n2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(n2) val=0.9 rise=2
  
  quit
.endc
.end
